published_rows.label: NVIDIA ACE target envelope
published_rows.notes: NVIDIA technical blogs describe ACE or NVIGI as real-time, low-latency inference. ACE release notes list 198 ms algorithmic latency for Speech Live Portrait, which the repo rounds to a 200 ms target envelope.

published_rows.label: Inworld TTS-1 first audio chunk
published_rows.notes: The August 15, 2025 Inworld blog reports the first two-second audio chunk in as few as 200 ms, excluding networking.

published_rows.label: Inworld TTS-1.5 first audio chunk
published_rows.notes: The January 21, 2026 Inworld blog reports P90 time-to-first-audio under 250 ms for Max and under 130 ms for Mini.

published_rows.label: Inworld end-to-end conversational guidance
published_rows.notes: Official Runtime guidance published by Inworld staff in November 2025 says a full audio-input to audio-output turn is typically about 1-3 seconds.
